Queen bee

Type: Material | Internal ID: QueenBee | Source: Wild Beehives | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Queen bee is a material dropped by Wild Beehives.

Building. • Beehive

Note. Queen bees are not renewable, there is a fix number per world determined by the number of randomly spawned wild beehive. It can be estimated on average at around one hundred per world.
